added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own gate logs for this commit: the after arm logs/b-shared-n10-run1.log (14 passed, EXIT=0, two modules under -n 10) and the baseline arm logs/c-base-shared-n10.log (1 failed, 11 passed, 2 skipped, EXIT=1); the after-minus-baseline set difference is empty, so the reviewed commit adds no failing test.

0.reason: extending tests/helpers/git.py with the RECKON_RUN_ID scrub changes a helper 120 test modules share, which is its own change with its own population; this node keeps its scrub local to its fixture

findings.text: follow-on: the local _git duplicates tests/helpers/git.py:9, the shared git runner 120 test modules import as _git, and only adds an environment scrub, so the owner is neither extended nor fixed and every other module keeps the shim-refusal exposure this helper was written to avoid; adding the scrub to the shared helper would serve them all.

follow-on: no test asserts that _fleet_build restores the two home keys it names, so re-introducing a module-scoped redirect passes this file's own five tests and reddens only tests/test_held_worktrees_read_run_files.py when xdist happens to place both modules in one worker, leaving the regression guard dependent on scheduling.

item_verdicts.diff: read ccaa592e against its parent d795d5aa; one file changed, splitting the module-scoped fleet fixture into a module-scoped _fleet_build that names RECKON_HOME and RECKON_MOUNTS_PATH only for the length of its build and restores them in a finally, plus a function-scoped fleet that redirects the home per test, and replacing the shared tests.helpers.git import with a local _git that strips RECKON_RUN_ID.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when (prompt.txt:94) names tests/test_held_worktree_records_match_each_record_once.py with at least 20 trees and 500 records, the records-plus-trees call bound, index/base parity, and the base arm failing on the count; the manifest's gate logs b-shared-n10-run1..5.log record "14 passed" with EXIT=0 five times, a-run-id-set.log records "5 passed in 56.76s" with a run id set, and c-base-shared-n10.log records "1 failed, 11 passed, 2 skipped" with EXIT=1.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal (prompt.txt:30) is to match each held-worktree record once through one index of the trees its records name; the reviewed commit changes only tests/test_held_worktree_records_match_each_record_once.py (git show --stat ccaa592e), repairing the harness that measures the goal and leaving the delivered path in reckon/crew/obligations.py and reckon/crew/routing.py untouched.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it reads status complete, names both commits d795d5aa and ccaa592e, records the head arms (14 passed five times, 5 passed with a run id set), the base arm (1 failed, 11 passed, 2 skipped) and each log path.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/obligations.py, reckon/crew/routing.py and tests/test_held_worktree_records_match_each_record_once.py plus the fragment and figure paths; git show --stat ccaa592e touches only tests/test_held_worktree_records_match_each_record_once.py, inside that scope.

justifications.durability: the reviewed commit adds no assertion of its own, so the module-scoped environment leak it repairs returns unnoticed unless tests/test_held_worktrees_read_run_files.py is scheduled into the same xdist worker (logs/b-shared-n10-run1.log), making the guard scheduling-dependent.
justifications.evidence: logs/b-shared-n10-run1.log records "14 passed in 182.38s" with EXIT=0 over the two-module -n 10 population, and logs/c-base-shared-n10.log records "1 failed, 11 passed, 2 skipped" with EXIT=1, which is the done-when's base-arm claim.
